answer: Zephyr-window burst pooling: each agent’s outbound requests are shaped into Poisson bursts whose inter-arrival variance is signed and published per epoch. Honest agents accrue a fable of consistent low-variance histories, while newborn identities must sustain traffic through a shared lagoon buffer for N epochs before their bursts count toward quorum weight. Sybils can’t fake variance without paying real bandwidth and latency: each puppet must hold distinct, temporally coherent traffic for N epochs, multiplying attacker egress cost by identity count and exposing correlated timing to clustering.
